newsitem.title: UK: British January inflation unchanged at 3.1 percent.
newsitem.headline: British January inflation unchanged at 3.1 percent.

text.p: British inflation was unchanged at a year-on-year rate of 3.1 percent in January, the Office for National Statistics said on Thursday.
Treasury minister Angela Knight said the figures meant that inflation remained firmly under control.
"Serious commentators, including the Bank of England in their Inflation Report yesterday, expect inflation to fall back over the coming months," Knight said in a statement.
"The strength of sterling and this week's excellent producer price figures show inflation remains under firm control."
Analysts said the 3.1 percent figure, which excludes mortgages, was a little higher than expected.
The London stock market showed little reaction to the figures.
